question: Which street has the highest number of 3 star restaurants?
output_text: Based on the available data, no single street has more than one restaurant with an average rating of exactly 3 stars. Each 3-star restaurant in the dataset is located on a unique street address.

messages.content: Which street has the highest number of 3 star restaurants?

messages.name: get_schema

args.query:
SELECT split_part(address, ',', 1) AS street, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM establishments
WHERE avg_rating = 3
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;
